title: Recurrent Modular Structure in Spiking Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.14262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological neural circuits are both modular and recurrent, with dense communities sparsely linked to one another. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) for reinforcement learning are usually feed-forward, and it is unclear how to obtain functional modules in a recurrent SNN or what they buy. In this work, we introduce a class of spiking networks, called Community Recurrent SNNs (CoRe SNNs): recurrent networks partitioned into communities with fixed roles. A controller community receives the stimulus, each action has its own community, and latent communities carry internal state. Spiking activity is then a walk between communities, and the action is the community the walk reaches. All learning is local and three-factor, and the recurrent communities are closer to cortical microcircuits than a feed-forward actor. translated_title: 脉冲神经网络强化学习中的循环模块化结构
translated_abstract: 生物神经回路既是模块化的又是循环的，密集的群落之间稀疏地相互连接。用于强化学习的脉冲神经网络（SNN）通常是前馈式的，如何在循环SNN中获得功能模块、以及这些模块能带来什么益处，目前尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们引入了一类脉冲网络，称为群落循环SNN（CoRe SNNs）：这是一种被划分为具有固定角色的群落的循环网络。控制器群落接收刺激，每个动作都有属于自己的群落，而潜在群落则携带内部状态。脉冲活动因此成为群落之间的一次游走，动作即游走最终到达的群落。所有学习都是局部的三因子学习，并且这些循环群落比前馈actor更接近皮层微回路。我们比较了获得这些群落的三种机制：动态模块化，其中我们提出的一种新学习规则Map-STDP鼓励……
tldr: 提出群落循环脉冲神经网络，将循环网络划分为具有固定角色的群落（控制器、动作和潜在状态群落），并结合局部三因子学习规则及新提出的Map-STDP，使脉冲强化学习网络结构更接近生物皮层微回路。
en_tdlr: We introduce Community Recurrent SNNs (CoRe SNNs), recurrent spiking networks partitioned into communities with fixed roles, enabling modular reinforcement learning with local three-factor learning (including a new Map-STDP rule) that is structurally closer to cortical microcircuits than feed-forward actors.
